datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2019, classifying geographic areas by food insecurity phase. The data represents near-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions, with classifications stored as spatial features (GeoJSON/KML) linked to collection dates and scenarios.
